grammar: pron. 我们自己；与主语 we 对应。by ourselves 可表示独自完成。
collocations: by ourselves; enjoy ourselves; help ourselves to sth
commonMistake: ourselves 是 we 的反身代词；表示“我们自己”时不可写成 ourself，也不要误用宾格 us。

example.english: We prepared the first-aid poster ourselves.
example.chinese: 我们自己制作了这张急救海报。

application.prompt: We made this first-aid poster by ____. A. ourselves B. themselves
application.solution: A。解析：主语 We 对应反身代词 ourselves，by ourselves 表示“我们自己”。

grammar: adj. 疼痛的；酸痛的。可作定语或表语。
collocations: a sore throat; sore muscles; feel sore
commonMistake: sore 常修饰身体部位（a sore throat）或作表语（feel sore）；表示持续疼痛也可用 hurt/ache，按句型选词。

example.english: My throat is sore after the long speech.
example.chinese: 长时间演讲后，我的喉咙很痛。

application.prompt: After giving three speeches, my throat felt ____. A. sorely B. sore
application.solution: B。解析：felt 后接形容词 sore，表示喉咙酸痛；sorely 是副词。

grammar: n. 喉咙。常见搭配 a sore throat、clear one’s throat；表示颈部外侧通常用 neck。
collocations: a sore throat; clear one’s throat; a dry throat
commonMistake: throat 指喉咙，neck 指颈部；a sore throat 是常见搭配，别把两处身体部位混淆。

example.english: Drink some water if your throat feels dry.
example.chinese: 如果你觉得喉咙干，就喝些水。

application.prompt: I drink warm tea when my ____ feels dry. A. throat B. stomach
application.solution: A。解析：dry throat 指喉咙干；stomach 是胃。

grammar: n. 胃痛；肚子疼。常用 have/get a stomachache，单数前通常加 a。
collocations: have a stomachache; get a stomachache; a bad stomachache
commonMistake: 常用 have/get a stomachache；表达胃部疼痛时不要误写成 stomachache pain。

example.english: He stayed home because he had a stomachache.
example.chinese: 他因为胃痛待在了家里。

application.prompt: After eating too much, he complained of a ____. A. earache B. stomachache
application.solution: B。解析：吃得过多后肚子疼，对应 stomachache。

grammar: n. 头痛。常用 have/get a headache；headache 前通常用 a。
collocations: have a headache; get a headache; a bad headache
commonMistake: 表示头痛常说 have/get a headache；headache 是可数名词，单数前通常加 a。

example.english: She took a rest because she had a headache.
example.chinese: 她因为头痛休息了一会儿。

application.prompt: After staring at the screen all day, she had a ____. A. headache B. backache
application.solution: A。解析：长时间看屏幕后头痛，对应 headache。

grammar: n. 牙痛。常用 have/get a toothache；牙齿疼也可说 one’s tooth hurts。
collocations: have a toothache; get a toothache; a bad toothache
commonMistake: toothache 指牙痛；说“我牙疼”可用 have a toothache，不能把 toothache 当作疼痛动作的动词。

example.english: He made a dentist’s appointment because of a toothache.
example.chinese: 他因为牙痛预约了牙医。

application.prompt: The dentist treated my ____ because one tooth hurt. A. stomachache B. toothache
application.solution: B。解析：牙齿疼需要看牙，对应 toothache。

grammar: n. 背痛；腰痛。常说 have a backache 或 suffer from backache。
collocations: have a backache; suffer from backache; a bad backache
commonMistake: backache 指背部或腰部疼痛；注意它与 back（背部）本身不是同一词性。

example.english: After lifting the box, she had a backache.
example.chinese: 搬完箱子后，她腰背疼。

application.prompt: After carrying heavy boxes, she had a ____ in her lower back. A. backache B. headache
application.solution: A。解析：lower back 疼对应 backache（腰背痛）。

grammar: v. 受苦；遭受。可直接接 pain/loss，也可用 suffer from + 疾病/困扰。
collocations: suffer pain; suffer a loss; suffer from an illness
commonMistake: suffer pain/a loss 直接接宾语；疾病或困扰常用 suffer from，不要把两种结构混写。

example.english: Many people suffer during a long drought.
example.chinese: 长期干旱期间，许多人遭受苦难。

application.prompt: Many families ____ heavy losses in the flood last year. A. suffer B. suffered
application.solution: B。解析：last year 表示过去，suffer 的过去式为 suffered；suffer a loss 不加 from。

grammar: phr. 遭受；受……折磨。后接名词，常指疾病、疼痛或困难。
collocations: suffer from a disease; suffer from stress; suffer from a lack of sleep
commonMistake: suffer from 后接疾病、疼痛或问题名词；主语为 he/she/it 时现在时用 suffers from。

example.english: He suffers from asthma and carries medicine with him.
example.chinese: 他患有哮喘，随身带着药。

application.prompt: He often ____ asthma, so he always carries an inhaler. A. suffers from B. suffer from
application.solution: A。解析：suffer from 后接疾病，主语 he 用 suffers；第三人称单数动词要加 -s。

grammar: v. 按；压。一般现在时第三人称单数为 presses，过去式和过去分词为 pressed。
collocations: press a button; press hard; press the doorbell
commonMistake: press a button 表示按按钮；press on 可表示继续施压，不能在普通按钮搭配中随意加 on。

example.english: Press the green button to start the machine.
example.chinese: 按下绿色按钮启动机器。

application.prompt: To start the machine, ____ the green button once. A. turn B. press
application.solution: B。解析：启动机器要按按钮，用 press a button。

grammar: n. 鼻出血。常说 have/get a nosebleed；可数名词单数前通常加 a。
collocations: have a nosebleed; get a nosebleed; stop a nosebleed
commonMistake: nosebleed 是可数名词，常说 have/get a nosebleed；表示流鼻血也可说 one’s nose is bleeding。

example.english: The nurse helped the boy when he had a nosebleed.
example.chinese: 男孩流鼻血时，护士帮助了他。

application.prompt: The boy had a ____ after the ball hit his nose. A. nosebleed B. cough
application.solution: A。解析：鼻子被球撞后流鼻血，对应 a nosebleed。

grammar: n. 牙科医生。常用 see/visit a dentist；定期看牙也可说 see the dentist。
collocations: see a dentist; visit the dentist; a children’s dentist
commonMistake: dentist 指牙医；去看牙医常说 see/visit a dentist 或 the dentist，不说 look a dentist。

example.english: I visit the dentist twice a year.
example.chinese: 我每年看两次牙医。

application.prompt: You should see a ____ twice a year to keep your teeth healthy. A. patient B. dentist
application.solution: B。解析：定期检查牙齿要看 dentist（牙医）。

grammar: n. 发烧。常见表达 have a fever、run a fever、a high fever。
collocations: have a fever; a high fever; run a fever
commonMistake: 常用 have a fever 或 run a fever；表达发烧时 fever 前通常有 a。

example.english: She has a fever, so she will stay home today.
example.chinese: 她发烧了，所以今天会待在家里。

application.prompt: Her temperature is 39°C. She has a ____. A. fever B. nosebleed
application.solution: A。解析：高体温对应 fever；nosebleed 是鼻出血。

grammar: n. 胃；腹部。stomach pain 表示胃痛，stomachache 表示胃痛这一症状。
collocations: an upset stomach; stomach pain; an empty stomach
commonMistake: stomach 是胃/腹部，stomachache 才是胃痛；两者不要互换。

example.english: The doctor asked where his stomach hurt.
example.chinese: 医生问他胃的哪里疼。

application.prompt: The doctor asked which part of his ____ hurt after the meal. A. forehead B. stomach
application.solution: B。解析：饭后腹部不适，医生询问 stomach（胃/腹部）。

grammar: v. 避免；防止。avoid 后接名词或动名词，不接不定式。
collocations: avoid a mistake; avoid doing sth; avoid danger
commonMistake: avoid 后接名词或动名词，不能接 to do；例如 avoid making the same mistake。

example.english: To avoid getting sick, wash your hands often.
example.chinese: 为了避免生病，要经常洗手。

application.prompt: To avoid catching a cold, remember to ____ sharing cups. A. avoid B. enjoy
application.solution: A。解析：avoid 后接动名词 sharing，表示避免共用杯子。

grammar: n. 气体；燃气。通常作不可数名词。
collocations: gas station; natural gas; gas stove
commonMistake: gas 表示气体/燃气时通常不可数；加油站语境中的 gas 也可指汽油，依上下文判断。

example.english: We turned off the gas before leaving the kitchen.
example.chinese: 离开厨房前，我们关掉了燃气。

application.prompt: The old stove burns natural ____. A. flame B. gas
application.solution: B。解析：natural gas 是“天然气”的固定搭配。

grammar: n. & v. 疼痛。作动词可说 My legs ache；作名词常见于 headache/toothache。
collocations: a stomachache; a toothache; aches and pains
commonMistake: ache 作动词时可说 My head aches；作名词常见于 headache/toothache 等复合词，注意句中位置。

example.english: After the long walk, my legs began to ache.
example.chinese: 长途步行后，我的腿开始疼。

application.prompt: My legs have been ____ since the long walk. A. aching B. ached
application.solution: A。解析：have been 后用现在分词 aching，表示腿一直在疼。

grammar: n. X 光检查；X 光片。X-ray 读音以元音音素开头，单数前用 an。
collocations: have an X-ray; an X-ray image; an X-ray machine
commonMistake: X-ray 读音以元音音素开头，单数前用 an；常说 have/get an X-ray。

example.english: The doctor ordered an X-ray of his wrist.
example.chinese: 医生安排给他的手腕拍一张 X 光片。

application.prompt: The doctor ordered an ____ to check for a broken wrist. A. operation B. X-ray
application.solution: B。解析：检查手腕是否骨折可拍 X-ray（X 光片）。

grammar: adj. 不小心的；粗心的。可作定语或表语。
collocations: a careless mistake; be careless with; careless driving
commonMistake: careless 是形容词，可修饰 mistake；副词形式 carefully/carelessly 要修饰动词。

example.english: He forgot to check his work and made a careless mistake.
example.chinese: 他忘了检查作业，犯了一个粗心的错误。

application.prompt: He didn't check his work and made a ____ mistake. A. careless B. carefully
application.solution: A。解析：修饰名词 mistake 要用形容词 careless。

grammar: adj. 流鼻涕的；流眼泪的。可作定语或表语。
collocations: a runny nose; runny eyes; have a runny nose
commonMistake: runny 是形容词，常见搭配 a runny nose；不能用副词 runnily 修饰 nose。

example.english: She has a runny nose because of her cold.
example.chinese: 她感冒了，流鼻涕。

application.prompt: My cold gives me a ____ nose. A. run B. runny
application.solution: B。解析：名词 nose 前用形容词 runny，构成 runny nose（流鼻涕）。

grammar: n. & v. 咳嗽。作名词常说 have a cough；作动词可直接接副词，如 cough loudly。
collocations: have a cough; cough loudly; a bad cough
commonMistake: 作名词常说 have a cough；作动词时直接说 cough，不要把名词搭配套进动词句。

example.english: He covered his mouth when he began to cough.
example.chinese: 他开始咳嗽时捂住了嘴。

application.prompt: The doctor asked whether I had a dry ____ that kept me awake. A. cough B. cold
application.solution: A。解析：a dry cough（干咳）会影响睡眠；cold 通常指感冒。

grammar: adj. 受了擦伤的。可作定语或表语。
collocations: a bruised knee; bruised skin; feel bruised
commonMistake: bruised 是 bruise 的过去分词/形容词，描述青紫或挫伤状态；名词/动词原形 bruise 不能直接作表语。

example.english: She fell off her bike and bruised her knee.
example.chinese: 她从自行车上摔下来，膝盖擦伤了。

application.prompt: The fall left her knee badly ____. A. bruise B. bruised
application.solution: B。解析：left + 宾语 + 形容词/分词作宾补；此处用 bruised 描述膝盖受伤状态。

grammar: phr. 请坐；坐下。常用于礼貌邀请。
collocations: take a seat; take a seat by the window; please take a seat
commonMistake: take a seat 是礼貌的“请坐”；不要按中文直译成 sit a seat。

example.english: Please take a seat while you wait for the doctor.
example.chinese: 等医生时请坐下。

application.prompt: Please ____ while you wait for the doctor. A. take a seat B. take your temperature
application.solution: A。解析：请候诊时坐下，用礼貌表达 take a seat。

grammar: phr. 给某人量体温。sb’s 要换成相应的所有格，如 my, his, her。
collocations: take a patient’s temperature; take someone’s temperature; check a child’s temperature
commonMistake: sb’s 要换成实际所有格（take her temperature）；不能把被量体温者写成宾语代词 her。

example.english: The nurse took my temperature before the doctor saw me.
example.chinese: 医生给我看诊前，护士先给我量了体温。

application.prompt: Before the consultation, the nurse ____ to check if I had a fever. A. took my seat B. took my temperature
application.solution: B。解析：量“我的体温”用 take my temperature，所有格要对应被量体温的人。

sources.label: Collins English Dictionary: take someone’s temperature

grammar: n. 测验；检查；v. 测试、检查。说“参加测验”用 take a test，说“检查某物”用 test sth。
collocations: take a test; test a machine; a medical test
commonMistake: test sth 表示检查/测试某物；参加测验通常说 take a test，注意两个搭配的动词不同。

example.english: The doctor will test his eyes tomorrow.
example.chinese: 医生明天会检查他的眼睛。

application.prompt: The eye doctor will ____ his eyesight tomorrow. A. test B. testing
application.solution: A。解析：will 后接动词原形 test；test one’s eyesight 表示检查视力。

grammar: n. 流行性感冒。通常作不可数名词。
collocations: have the flu; catch the flu; flu symptoms
commonMistake: 通常说 have/catch the flu，flu 前用 the；不要照搬 have a cold 的冠词。

example.english: Many students stayed home with the flu last week.
example.chinese: 上周许多学生因流感待在家里。

application.prompt: The doctor said she had ____ after examining her symptoms. A. a flu B. the flu
application.solution: B。解析：常说 have the flu，flu 前用定冠词 the。

grammar: n. 药；医学。通常作不可数名词。
collocations: take medicine; cough medicine; a bottle of medicine
commonMistake: 表示药物时 medicine 通常不可数，可说 take medicine/a medicine 的不同语义需按语境辨别；本单元“服药”用 take medicine。

example.english: Take this medicine after meals, as the doctor advised.
example.chinese: 按照医生的建议，饭后服用这种药。

application.prompt: The label says to take this ____ after meals. A. medicine B. sick
application.solution: A。解析：take medicine 表示服药；medicine 在“药物”义通常不可数。

grammar: n. 口罩；面具。常说 wear/put on a mask，可数名词单数前通常加 a。
collocations: wear a mask; a face mask; put on a mask
commonMistake: 表示戴口罩用 wear/put on a mask；wear 强调佩戴状态，put on 强调动作。

example.english: Please wear a mask if you have a cough.
example.chinese: 如果你咳嗽，请戴上口罩。

application.prompt: If you have a cough, please ____ to protect people around you. A. wear mask B. wear a mask
application.solution: B。解析：表示戴口罩用 wear a mask；单数可数名词 mask 前需要冠词 a。

grammar: phr. 阻止……做某事。结构为 stop + 宾语 + (from) doing；被动结构通常保留 from。
collocations: stop sb from doing sth; prevent sth from happening; stop the spread of a virus
commonMistake: stop sb from doing sth 中 from 可省略，但后面的动词仍用 -ing；不要写成 stop sb to do 来表达“阻止”。

example.english: The mask helps stop germs from spreading.
example.chinese: 口罩有助于阻止细菌传播。

application.prompt: A mask can stop germs ____ from one person to another. A. spreading B. to spread
application.solution: A。解析：stop germs from spreading 符合 stop + 宾语 + from doing 结构。

grammar: n. 病毒。复数为 viruses；可说 a virus spreads 或 spread a virus。
collocations: a computer virus; a flu virus; spread a virus
commonMistake: virus 的复数是 viruses；不要误写成不规则拼法 virii。

example.english: The doctor explained how the virus spreads.
example.chinese: 医生解释了这种病毒如何传播。

application.prompt: A ____ can spread between people and make them ill. A. vitamin B. virus
application.solution: B。解析：能在人与人之间传播并致病的是 virus（病毒）。

grammar: n. 描写；形容。动词为 describe，常用 a description of sth。
collocations: give a description; a clear description of; describe sth clearly
commonMistake: description 是名词，常用 a description of sth；describe 是对应动词，别混用冠词 a。

example.english: The witness gave a clear description of the lost bag.
example.chinese: 目击者清楚地描述了那个丢失的包。

application.prompt: The witness gave a clear ____ of the missing bag. A. description B. describe
application.solution: A。解析：give a description of 是名词搭配；describe 是动词。

grammar: n. 病人；adj. 有耐心的。patient 作名词指病人，作形容词常用 be patient with sb。
collocations: a patient with a fever; be patient with sb; patient care
commonMistake: patient 作名词是“病人”，作形容词是“有耐心的”；be patient with sb 是后者的搭配。

example.english: The doctor spoke kindly to the patient.
example.chinese: 医生和蔼地对病人说话。

application.prompt: The doctor spoke kindly to the ____ in Room 4. A. illness B. patient
application.solution: B。解析：to 后需要名词，Room 4 里的病人是 patient。

grammar: n. 伤害；损伤。常说 a knee/head injury；动词“使受伤”为 injure。
collocations: a serious injury; a head injury; recover from an injury
commonMistake: injury 是名词，injure 是动词；a knee injury 与 injure one’s knee 结构不同。

example.english: He missed the game because of a knee injury.
example.chinese: 他因膝盖受伤错过了比赛。

application.prompt: He missed the game because of a knee ____. A. injury B. injure
application.solution: A。解析：a knee 后接名词 injury；injure 是动词。

grammar: n. 疾病。常见搭配 a serious illness、recover from an illness；ill 是形容词。
collocations: a serious illness; recover from an illness; prevent illness
commonMistake: illness 是名词；be ill/get ill 用形容词 ill，不能说 an ill 表示一种疾病。

example.english: She returned to school after her illness.
example.chinese: 病愈后，她回到了学校。

application.prompt: After a serious ____, she returned to school. A. ill B. illness
application.solution: B。解析：serious 修饰名词 illness；ill 是形容词。

grammar: n. 刀；可数名词，复数为 knives。
collocations: a sharp knife; cut with a knife; a kitchen knife
commonMistake: knife 的复数为 knives，变复数时 f 变 v 再加 -es。

example.english: Use a clean knife to cut the fruit.
example.chinese: 用一把干净的刀切水果。

application.prompt: Please use a sharp ____ to cut the apple. A. knife B. fork
application.solution: A。解析：切苹果通常用 knife（刀），sharp 也与刀具搭配。

grammar: n. 安全；安全处所。通常作不可数名词。
collocations: road safety; safety rules; for your safety
commonMistake: safety 是名词，safe 是形容词；safety rules 与 keep sb safe 的词性不要混淆。

example.english: Always follow the safety rules in the science lab.
example.chinese: 在科学实验室里一定要遵守安全规则。

application.prompt: Everyone must follow the lab ____ rules. A. safely B. safety
application.solution: B。解析：名词 safety 作定语构成 safety rules（安全规则）；safely 是副词。

grammar: adj. 清晰的；v. 清理、清除。根据句中位置判断词性。
collocations: clear instructions; clear a table; make sth clear
commonMistake: clear 可作形容词（clear instructions）或动词（clear the table）；修饰动词时用 clearly。

example.english: Please make your answer clear and easy to understand.
example.chinese: 请把答案说清楚，让人容易理解。

application.prompt: The instructions were so ____ that every student understood them. A. clear B. clearly
application.solution: A。解析：be 后作表语、说明 instructions 的性质，用形容词 clear。

grammar: n. 疼痛；痛苦。通常作不可数名词。
collocations: feel pain; in pain; cause pain
commonMistake: pain 作“疼痛”通常不可数，常说 be in pain/feel pain；具体疼痛类型常用 a pain in...。

example.english: He felt pain in his ankle after the fall.
example.chinese: 摔倒后，他的脚踝感到疼痛。

application.prompt: After the fall, he was in great ____ but could still walk. A. painful B. pain
application.solution: B。解析：in great pain 是“疼痛难忍”的搭配，空格需要名词 pain。

grammar: phr. 更为重要的是；而且。常用于句首补充信息。
collocations: what’s more, ...; and what’s more; what is more
commonMistake: What’s more 用来补充或递进信息，句首常接逗号；不要把它当成举例标记。

example.english: The library is quiet and, what’s more, it is open late.
example.chinese: 图书馆很安静，而且开放到很晚。

application.prompt: This library has quiet rooms. ____, it stays open until 10 p.m. A. What’s more B. At first
application.solution: A。解析：后句补充图书馆的另一个优点，用 What’s more（而且）。

grammar: n. 亮度。通常作不可数名词。
collocations: screen brightness; adjust the brightness; brightness level
commonMistake: brightness 是 bright 加 -ness 构成的名词，表示亮度；不能用 bright 直接替换名词位置。

example.english: I lowered the screen brightness before bed.
example.chinese: 睡前我调低了屏幕亮度。

application.prompt: I turned down the screen ____ so it was easier to read at night. A. bright B. brightness
application.solution: B。解析：turn down 后接名词 brightness（亮度）；bright 是形容词。

grammar: n. 环境。通常作不可数名词。
collocations: protect the environment; a healthy environment; environmental protection
commonMistake: environment 通常作可数名词谈一种环境，也常用 the environment 指自然环境；environmental 是形容词。

example.english: We should keep the environment clean by recycling paper.
example.chinese: 我们应该通过回收纸张来保持环境清洁。

application.prompt: We should protect the natural ____ by recycling paper. A. environment B. environmental
application.solution: A。解析：protect the natural environment 是“保护自然环境”；environmental 是形容词。

grammar: v. 穿越；横过；cross 是动词，across 常作介词或副词。
collocations: cross the road; cross a bridge; cross one’s arms
commonMistake: cross 是动词，后可直接接 road/street；across 是介词/副词，不能说 across the road 作谓语。

example.english: Always look both ways before you cross the road.
example.chinese: 过马路前一定要向两边看。

application.prompt: Look both ways before you ____ the road. A. across B. cross
application.solution: B。解析：before you 后接句子，空格需用动词 cross；across 通常作介词/副词。

grammar: phr. 着火；起火。catch—caught—caught。
collocations: catch fire suddenly; a building catches fire; prevent a fire
commonMistake: catch fire 表示开始着火，fire 前一般不加 a；be on fire 表示处于燃烧状态。

example.english: The dry leaves caught fire quickly.
example.chinese: 干燥的树叶很快着了火。

application.prompt: Dry leaves can ____ quickly in hot weather. A. catch fire B. catch a fire
application.solution: A。解析：catch fire 表示“着火”，fire 前通常不加 a。

grammar: pron. 他们/她们/它们自己；与主语 they 对应。
collocations: by themselves; enjoy themselves; introduce themselves
commonMistake: themselves 对应复数主语 they；单数主语应根据人称改用 himself/herself/itself。

example.english: The children made the model themselves.
example.chinese: 孩子们自己做了这个模型。

application.prompt: The children built the model by ____. A. ourselves B. themselves
application.solution: B。解析：主语 The children 对应 themselves；by themselves 表示“他们自己”。

grammar: v. 油炸；油煎；油炒。fry—fried—fried；现在分词 frying。
collocations: fry an egg; fried rice; deep-fry food
commonMistake: fry 的过去式和过去分词是 fried；现在分词 frying，注意 y 前为辅音时的拼写变化。

example.english: Dad fried some eggs for breakfast.
example.chinese: 爸爸煎了几个鸡蛋当早餐。

application.prompt: Dad ____ two eggs for breakfast this morning. A. fried B. fryed
application.solution: A。解析：this morning 的动作已完成，fry 的过去式为 fried，变 y 为 i 再加 -ed。

grammar: phr. 打开电器、水或煤气。代词作宾语时放中间：turn it on。
collocations: turn on the light; turn on the tap; turn the radio on
commonMistake: turn on 是可分离短语动词；宾语是代词时必须放中间（turn it on），不能说 turn on it。

example.english: Turn on the light so we can read.
example.chinese: 把灯打开，这样我们就能看书了。

application.prompt: It is dark in here. Please ____ the light. A. turn off B. turn on
application.solution: B。解析：房间很暗，需要打开灯，用 turn on。

grammar: n. 厨房灶具；炉子。常说 a gas stove、turn off the stove。
collocations: a gas stove; a kitchen stove; turn off the stove
commonMistake: stove 指炉灶/火炉；gas stove 是燃气灶，不要和 stove top 上的 flame（火焰）混为一词。

example.english: Turn off the stove after you finish cooking.
example.chinese: 做完饭后把炉子关掉。

application.prompt: She cooked soup on the gas ____. A. stove B. flame
application.solution: A。解析：gas stove 是“燃气灶”；flame 是火焰。

grammar: adv. 快乐地；高兴地。通常修饰动词、形容词或整句。
collocations: live happily; smile happily; play happily
commonMistake: happily 是副词，修饰动作；形容词 happy 可作表语或修饰名词，注意 -y 到 -ily 的拼写。

example.english: The children played happily in the garden.
example.chinese: 孩子们在花园里开心地玩耍。

application.prompt: The children played ____ in the garden all afternoon. A. happy B. happily
application.solution: B。解析：修饰动词 played 要用副词 happily。

grammar: phr. 不可能；没门，也可表示“没有办法”，结合语境理解。
collocations: no way!; there is no way to do sth; no way of knowing
commonMistake: No way! 可表示强烈拒绝；there is no way to do sth 则表示“没有办法做”，需按语境辨义。

example.english: “Can I borrow your bike?” “No way; I need it today.”
example.chinese: “我能借你的自行车吗？”“不行，我今天要用。”

application.prompt: Can I borrow your bike? ____! I need it today. A. No way B. Of course
application.solution: A。解析：这里是在拒绝借车，No way 表示“绝不/没门”；Of course 表示同意。

grammar: n./v. 燃烧；烧伤。过去式和过去分词可为 burnt 或 burned。
collocations: burn wood; get burned; burn down
commonMistake: burn 的过去式和过去分词可用 burned 或 burnt；不规则变化与规则变化都可见，保持全文用法一致。

example.english: Be careful not to burn your hand on the hot pan.
example.chinese: 小心别被热锅烫伤手。

application.prompt: Be careful not to ____ your hand on the hot pan. A. burned B. burn
application.solution: B。解析：not to 后接动词原形 burn；burned 是过去式/过去分词。

grammar: phr. 着火；起火。be on fire 描述正在燃烧的状态。
collocations: be on fire; a house on fire; put out a fire
commonMistake: be on fire 描述正在着火；catch fire 表示开始着火，注意状态与起始动作的区别。

example.english: The firefighters saw that the roof was on fire.
example.chinese: 消防员看到屋顶着火了。

application.prompt: The firefighters saw that the roof was ____. A. on fire B. on flame
application.solution: A。解析：描述屋顶正在燃烧用 be on fire。

grammar: n. 火焰。可数名词，单数前通常加 a/an；复数 flames。
collocations: a bright flame; a candle flame; put out the flames
commonMistake: flame 指可见的火焰，fire 可指火或火灾；讲火焰的形状/颜色时通常选 flame。

example.english: A small flame appeared when he lit the match.
example.chinese: 他划火柴时出现了一小簇火焰。

application.prompt: A small ____ rose from the candle wick. A. firework B. flame
application.solution: B。解析：蜡烛芯上升起的是一小簇 flame（火焰）。

grammar: n. 惊恐；恐慌；v. 惊慌。作动词过去式为 panicked，注意双写 c。
collocations: panic about sth; in a panic; panic and run
commonMistake: panic 可作名词或动词；作动词时过去式、过去分词常写 panicked，注意双写 c 后加 -ed。

example.english: Do not panic if the fire alarm rings; follow the teacher.
example.chinese: 如果火警响起，不要慌张，要听从老师安排。

application.prompt: When the alarm rings, don't ____. Follow the teacher's instructions. A. panic B. panicly
application.solution: A。解析：don't 后用动词原形 panic；panicly 不是正确拼法。

grammar: prep. 向……上；到……上。强调移动到表面，和表示进入内部的 into 区分。
collocations: onto; use the expression in context; keep the word order
commonMistake: onto 表示向某个表面移动并到达其上；into 强调进入内部空间，结合动作终点判断。

example.english: The teacher wrote “onto” on the board during the health lesson.
example.chinese: 健康课上，老师把“onto”写在了黑板上。

application.prompt: She stepped ____ the platform and sat down. A. into B. onto
application.solution: B。解析：step onto 表示踏上一个表面/平台；into 强调进入内部空间。

grammar: n./v. 扔；抛；投。throw—threw—thrown。
collocations: throw a ball; throw sth away; throw sth to sb
commonMistake: throw—threw—thrown 是不规则变化；扔给某人常说 throw sth to sb，扔掉用 throw sth away。

example.english: She threw the ball to her teammate.
example.chinese: 她把球扔给了队友。

application.prompt: Don't ____ rubbish into the river. A. throw B. roll
application.solution: A。解析：把垃圾扔进河里用 throw；roll 表示滚动。

grammar: v. （使）滚动；翻滚。过去式和过去分词 rolled；也可作名词表示一卷/一小面包。
collocations: roll down a hill; roll up a sleeve; a roll of paper
commonMistake: roll 可表示滚动，也可接 up 表示卷起；“roll up one’s sleeves”中宾语位置不能漏。

example.english: The ball rolled under the table.
example.chinese: 球滚到了桌子下面。

application.prompt: The ball began to ____ down the hill. A. rolled B. roll
application.solution: B。解析：begin to 后接动词原形 roll。

grammar: adj. 快的；迅速的，也可作副词；副词通常用 quickly。
collocations: a quick answer; a quick look; be quick to do sth
commonMistake: quick 主要作形容词，修饰名词；正式写作中修饰动词通常用 quickly。

example.english: We had a quick lunch before the meeting.
example.chinese: 开会前我们匆匆吃了午饭。

application.prompt: We had a ____ lunch before the meeting. A. quick B. quickly
application.solution: A。解析：名词 lunch 前用形容词 quick；副词 quickly 不能直接修饰名词。

grammar: phr. 即将；正要做某事。be about to + 动词原形，常与 when 连用。
collocations: be about to leave; be about to start; be just about to do sth
commonMistake: be about to 后接动词原形，表示眼看就要发生；通常不与具体将来时间点连用。

example.english: We were about to leave when the phone rang.
example.chinese: 我们正要离开，这时电话响了。

application.prompt: We were ____ leave when the phone rang. A. about B. about to
application.solution: B。解析：be about to do 表示“正要做……”，to 后接动词原形。

grammar: phr. 突然停下；也可指险些做某事但没有做，结合上下文判断。
collocations: stop short; stop short of doing sth; come to a sudden stop
commonMistake: stop short of doing sth 表示差一点做某事但没有做；stop short 单独用可表示突然停下。

example.english: The cyclist stopped short when a child ran into the road.
example.chinese: 一个孩子跑到路上时，骑车人猛地停了下来。

application.prompt: The cyclist saw a child run into the road and had to ____. A. stop short B. stopped short
application.solution: A。解析：had to 后接动词原形 stop；stop short 表示突然停下。

grammar: n. & v. 援助；帮助。常见名词搭配 first aid、come to sb’s aid；作动词可直接接受助者。
collocations: first aid; provide aid; come to sb’s aid
commonMistake: aid 可作名词或动词；first aid 指急救，come to sb’s aid 指前去帮助某人，含义不同。

example.english: The neighbors came to the injured man’s aid.
example.chinese: 邻居们前来帮助受伤的男子。

application.prompt: When her neighbor fell, she came to his ____. A. first aid B. aid
application.solution: B。解析：come to someone’s aid 是“前来帮助某人”；first aid 指急救。

grammar: phr. 急救；通常作不可数名词。first-aid 可作复合形容词修饰名词。
collocations: give first aid; first-aid kit; first-aid training
commonMistake: first aid 通常作不可数名词，不说 a first aid；修饰名词时常写 first-aid kit。

example.english: The teacher learned first aid before leading the school trip.
example.chinese: 带领学校旅行前，老师学习了急救知识。

application.prompt: A first-aid kit is useful when someone needs ____. A. first aid B. an aid
application.solution: A。解析：needs first aid 表示需要急救；first aid 通常作不可数名词。

grammar: n. 灭火器。常用 fire extinguisher；可数名词单数前通常加限定词。
collocations: a fire extinguisher; use an extinguisher; extinguisher training
commonMistake: extinguisher 是可数名词，常见完整说法 fire extinguisher；单数前通常要有 a/an/the。

example.english: The fire extinguisher is beside the exit.
example.chinese: 灭火器在出口旁边。

application.prompt: Use a fire ____ to put out a small fire. A. alarm B. extinguisher
application.solution: B。解析：能扑灭小火的是 fire extinguisher（灭火器），alarm 只发出警报。

grammar: phr. 上馆子吃饭；在外用餐。eat 按时态变化。
collocations: eat out with friends; eat out tonight; prefer to eat out
commonMistake: eat out 指在餐馆等外出用餐；eat out 与 eat at home 对照，不等于把饭吃完（eat up）。

example.english: We eat out once a week, usually on Friday.
example.chinese: 我们每周出去吃一次，通常在星期五。

application.prompt: We don't feel like cooking, so let's ____ tonight. A. eat out B. eat up
application.solution: A。解析：不想做饭就去餐馆吃，用 eat out；eat up 是吃完。

grammar: adv. & n. 今晚；今夜。作时间副词时常直接置于句末，不加 on/at。
collocations: tonight’s dinner; see you tonight; work tonight
commonMistake: tonight 作时间副词时前面通常不加介词 on/at；可说 tonight’s dinner 表示今晚的晚餐。

example.english: I will finish my homework tonight.
example.chinese: 我今晚会完成作业。

application.prompt: I will finish the project ____ and hand it in tomorrow. A. at tonight B. tonight
application.solution: B。解析：tonight 作时间副词前通常不加 at。

grammar: adv. 伤心地；令人遗憾地。通常修饰动词、形容词或整句。
collocations: sadly, ...; smile sadly; end sadly
commonMistake: sadly 可作方式副词，也可作句子副词表达遗憾；句首作句子副词时常用逗号隔开。

example.english: Sadly, the old playground will close next month.
example.chinese: 令人遗憾的是，旧操场下个月就要关闭了。

application.prompt: ____, the old playground will close next month. A. Sadly B. Sad
application.solution: A。解析：句首修饰整句、表达遗憾，用副词 Sadly。

grammar: n. 烟；v. 吸烟、冒烟。表示烟时通常不可数；作动词可用 smoke from... 描述烟源。
collocations: smoke from a fire; smoke a cigarette; smoke detector
commonMistake: smoke 表示烟时通常不可数；作动词可表示吸烟/冒烟，判断词性看冠词和句法位置。

example.english: Smoke came from the pan when the oil got too hot.
example.chinese: 油太热时，锅里冒出了烟。

application.prompt: A thick cloud of ____ came from the kitchen. A. smoker B. smoke
application.solution: B。解析：a cloud of 后接名词 smoke（烟）；smoker 指吸烟者/烟具。

grammar: adv. 幸运地。通常修饰动词、形容词或整句。
collocations: luckily, ...; luckily for sb; luckily, everyone ...
commonMistake: luckily 是句子副词，表达“幸好”；句首常用逗号，别误写成形容词 lucky 修饰整句。

example.english: Luckily, the firefighters arrived in time.
example.chinese: 幸好，消防员及时赶到了。

application.prompt: ____, the firefighters arrived before the flames spread. A. Luckily B. Lucky
application.solution: A。解析：修饰整句说明“幸好”，用副词 Luckily。

grammar: adv. 严重地；差地；非常。比较级 worse，最高级 worst。
collocations: be badly hurt; behave badly; need sth badly
commonMistake: badly 是 bad 的副词，比较级和最高级是不规则的 worse、worst；不要写 badder。

example.english: The storm badly damaged several houses.
example.chinese: 暴风雨严重损坏了几所房子。

application.prompt: The storm ____ damaged several houses. A. bad B. badly
application.solution: B。解析：修饰动词 damaged 要用副词 badly。

grammar: n. 伤害；损害，通常不可数；v. 伤害。常用 do harm to。
collocations: do harm to; cause harm; be harmed by sth
commonMistake: harm 作“伤害”通常不可数，常用 do harm to；形容词形式 harmful 常见搭配 be harmful to。

example.english: Too much smoke can harm your lungs.
example.chinese: 烟雾太多会损害你的肺部。

application.prompt: Too much smoke can do ____ to your lungs. A. harm B. harmful
application.solution: A。解析：do harm to 是固定搭配，do 后用名词 harm。

grammar: n. 药丸；药片。可数名词，常说 take a pill/one pill。
collocations: take a pill; a sleeping pill; swallow a pill
commonMistake: pill 是可数名词，表示一片药时说 a pill/one pill；medicine 泛指药物时常不可数。

example.english: The doctor told him to take one pill after lunch.
example.chinese: 医生让他午饭后吃一片药。

application.prompt: The doctor told him to take one ____ after lunch. A. pills B. pill
application.solution: B。解析：one 后接可数名词单数 pill。

grammar: adj. 有害的。常用 be harmful to；名词 harm。
collocations: be harmful to health; harmful effects; harmful chemicals
commonMistake: harmful 是形容词，常说 be harmful to；harm 是名词/动词，不可直接放在 be 后作形容词。

example.english: Smoking is harmful to your health.
example.chinese: 吸烟有害健康。

application.prompt: Smoking is ____ to your health. A. harmful B. harm
application.solution: A。解析：be 动词后作表语需用形容词 harmful；常见搭配 harmful to。

grammar: n./v. 碰撞；击；打；hit—hit—hit；现在分词 hitting。
collocations: hit a ball; hit the ground; hit sb on the head
commonMistake: hit 的过去式、过去分词仍为 hit；现在分词需双写 t：hitting。

example.english: The ball hit the window, but the glass did not break.
example.chinese: 球打到了窗户，但玻璃没有碎。

application.prompt: The ball ____ the window, but the glass didn't break. A. hitted B. hit
application.solution: B。解析：句子用一般过去时；hit 的过去式仍是 hit，不加 -ed。

grammar: n./v. 震惊；使震惊。shocked 描述人的感受，shocking 描述事物。
collocations: be in shock; a great shock; shock sb
commonMistake: 人感到震惊用 shocked，令人震惊的事物用 shocking；不要仅根据中文“震惊”选词。

example.english: We were shocked by the sudden news.
example.chinese: 我们对这个突然的消息感到震惊。

application.prompt: We were ____ by the sudden news. A. shocked B. shocking
application.solution: A。解析：人感到震惊用 shocked；令人震惊的消息可说 shocking news。

grammar: v. 流血；出血。bleed—bled—bled。
collocations: bleed from the nose; bleed badly; stop the bleeding
commonMistake: bleed 的过去式和过去分词均为 bled；流血状态可说 be bleeding。

example.english: His finger began to bleed after he cut it.
example.chinese: 他割伤手指后，手指开始流血。

application.prompt: His finger ____ after he cut it. A. bleed B. bled
application.solution: B。解析：after 表示过去情境，bleed 的过去式是 bled。

grammar: n. 检查；v. 检查、核对。check sth 表示检查某物，check on sb 表示查看某人情况。
collocations: check a patient; check the answer; check for sth
commonMistake: check sth 表示检查某物；check on sb/sth 表示查看其情况，介词会改变搭配侧重点。

example.english: The nurse checked his temperature again.
example.chinese: 护士又给他量了一次体温。

application.prompt: The nurse will ____ his temperature again. A. check B. checks
application.solution: A。解析：will 后接动词原形；check one’s temperature 表示量体温。

grammar: adj. 憋气的；紧的；牢固的。可作定语或表语。
collocations: a tight shirt; hold on tight; tight shoes
commonMistake: tight 是形容词，描述衣物、绷带等松紧；副词 tightly 用来修饰 hold/grip 等动作。

example.english: The bandage was too tight around his wrist.
example.chinese: 绷带缠在他的手腕上太紧了。

application.prompt: The bandage is too ____ around my wrist; please loosen it. A. tightly B. tight
application.solution: B。解析：be too 后接形容词 tight 描述绷带松紧。

grammar: n. 花生。可数名词；单数前通常加 a/one，复数 peanuts。
collocations: peanut butter; a peanut allergy; a handful of peanuts
commonMistake: peanut 是可数名词，单数前用 a/one；peanuts 也常用于泛指食物或过敏原。

example.english: This snack contains peanuts, so read the label carefully.
example.chinese: 这种零食含有花生，所以要仔细看标签。

application.prompt: He picked up one ____ from the bowl. A. peanut B. peanuts
application.solution: A。解析：one 后用可数名词单数 peanut。

grammar: adv. 紧张不安地。通常修饰动词、形容词或整句。
collocations: smile nervously; wait nervously; look around nervously
commonMistake: nervously 是副词，修饰 wait/smile 等动作；形容词 nervous 用来描述人的状态。

example.english: He waited nervously outside the doctor’s room.
example.chinese: 他在医生诊室外紧张地等待。

application.prompt: He waited ____ outside the doctor's office. A. nervous B. nervously
application.solution: B。解析：修饰动词 waited 要用副词 nervously。

grammar: adj. 过敏的。常用 be allergic to + 名词；名词 allergy。
collocations: be allergic to peanuts; allergic reaction; severely allergic
commonMistake: 固定搭配是 be allergic to + 过敏原；不要把介词 to 换成 with/for。

example.english: My brother is allergic to peanuts.
example.chinese: 我弟弟对花生过敏。

application.prompt: My brother is ____ peanuts, so he never eats them. A. allergic to B. allergic with
application.solution: A。解析：固定搭配 be allergic to，to 后接过敏原。

grammar: phr. 从现在起；用于说明从现在开始持续的新习惯或决定。
collocations: from now on, ...; follow a rule from now on; from then on
commonMistake: from now on 指从现在开始并延续；from then on 指从过去某一时点开始，时态也要相应配合。

example.english: From now on, I will keep a first-aid kit in the car.
example.chinese: 从现在起，我会在车里放一个急救包。

application.prompt: ____, I will keep a first-aid kit in the car. A. From then on B. From now on
application.solution: B。解析：从现在开始的新习惯用 from now on；from then on 指从过去某时起。
